fairness: Frozen Experiment 9 weights. Only physical scales searched. No clipping, no Python output correction.
bias_compensation: Separate bias ammeter and CCCS gain k=G_WEIGHT/G_BIAS with Vref=1 V so V_b = b in SPICE.

current_cost.label: relative physical current cost
current_cost.note: I_rel = SigmaG * V_rep with V_rep=1 V. This is a relative conductance-derived metric, not measured board power. SPICE source current is the sum of |I| through Vin* and Vref at one representative operating point.

signal_normalization.reason: A constant inter-layer gain k with next-layer weights w/k preserves math but does not change the intra-layer ratio max|w|/min|w|. That ratio is what the resistor window R_MAX/R_MIN must cover. Normalization is therefore omitted.
